goal: Build the Tahoe desktop shell — wallpaper, transparent menu bar, magnifying Dock, full window manager, Spotlight/Control Center/Notification Center — consuming the Phase 1 design system.
summary:
Phase 2 (Desktop Shell & Window Manager) is complete. All 5 steps done:

1. **Desktop + wallpaper layer**: `src/shell/Desktop.tsx` renders `.desktop` root with 5 original gradient wallpapers from settings store
2. **MenuBar**: `src/shell/MenuBar.tsx` — transparent glass bar with Apple menu + app menus, hover-to-switch dropdowns, click-outside/Escape close, About This Mac overlay, View > Dark/Tinted appearance toggle, right-side floating icons wired to panels
3. **Dock**: `src/shell/Dock.tsx` — Liquid Glass dock with cosine-curve magnification (48px→72px), running-app indicators, tooltips, click-to-launch with bounce, 15 app icons + trash in `appRegistry.tsx`
4. **Window + WindowManager**: `src/store/windows.ts` (Zustand store: open/close/focus/minimize/restore/maximize/drag/resize/Spaces), `src/shell/Window.tsx` (traffic lights, drag, resize, maximize, minimize), `src/shell/WindowManager.tsx` (renders windows by Space, Cmd+W/M shortcuts)
5. **Panels**: `src/shell/Spotlight.tsx` (Cmd+Space toggle, search, app launch), `src/shell/ControlCenter.tsx` (toggles + sliders + appearance cycle), `src/shell/NotificationCenter.tsx` (calendar/weather widgets + mock notifications)

**Test results**: 44 Playwright e2e tests pass (3 shell-desktop + 7 shell-menubar + 7 shell-dock + 11 window-manager + 16 shell-panels). 43 Vitest unit tests pass. Build and lint clean.
stepSummaries:

  4. Window + WindowManager (src/shell/Window.tsx, src/shell/WindowManager.tsx): open (from Dock/Spotlight), drag, resize, minimize-to-Dock (genie), close, fullscreen, Spaces switching. [verified]
  5. Spotlight (Cmd+Space), Control Center, Notification Center panels (src/shell/Spotlight.tsx, ControlCenter.tsx, NotificationCenter.tsx). [verified]
